data.current_description: OpenAI Chat Completions format. `model` is an auto-* routing mode (see the RoutingModel schema), "auto" for your saved preference, or a model id from GET /v1/models to pin one. Text only. Tool calling, forced tool_choice, JSON output and streaming work on every model; a conversation stays on the model that gave its previous answer. Models rank on the mean of their last five measured runs; when the leaders are statistically tied, your tie-break preference picks among them (cheaper by default). On failure the router falls back along the chain (streaming: only before the first byte, or when a provider sends nothing for 120 s). A refusal comes back as message.refusal with finish_reason content_filter.
data.description_suggestion: Send a chat completion request using OpenAI-compatible format. The `model` parameter accepts auto-* routing modes (auto-coding, auto-reasoning, auto-tool-use), "auto" for your saved preference, or a specific model ID to bypass routing. Supports tool calling, JSON output, and streaming across all routable models. Conversations maintain model continuity—subsequent messages in a thread route to the same model that answered previously. Model selection uses benchmark rankings (mean of last 5 runs); tied leaders are broken by your preference (cheaper by default). On provider failure, automatically falls back along the configured chain. Refusals return as message.refusal with finish_reason content_filter.
